pages.text: Mom packed a picnic of fluffy bread and strawberry jam.
"Let's eat in the best spot!" Dodo and Mumu set off, holding opposite sides of the basket.
Dark clouds billowed across the sky. Mumu looked up.
Dodo pointed a wing at them. "Those aren't rain clouds. I know clouds!"
Patter, patter! Big raindrops poured down. A sudden shower.
They ran under the mill eaves. Droplets rolled from their feathers.
Dodo glared at the sky. "They looked just like the rainy ones."
Mumu set the basket on the doorstep. "This is the best spot. A rain-watching picnic!"
Side by side on the step, they ate bread. The rain sang, patter, patter.
The rain stopped, and a rainbow stretched over the fields. Dodo stood proud. "See? I even prepared a rainbow!" With jam on his mouth, Mumu giggled.
